_comment: Allowlist for check-resurrection-patterns.mjs. Add a path glob (e.g. 'packages/*/src/contracts/**') to permit verbatim re-adds that are intentional (e.g. shared monorepo modules mirrored in multiple package sub-trees). Keep this list SHORT and document each entry in 'reason'.
